title: Console Optimize: proactive token-savings guidance, safe-preview flow & immutable apply ledger
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and implement a recommendation-first UX for Redwood Optimize that surfaces batching & caching suggestions with an interactive diff preview and an append-only apply ledger. The goal is to increase safe adoption of automated cost reductions while preserving latency/QoS by providing trusted previews, canary rollout controls, observability hooks, and an auditable history for compliance and SRE troubleshooting.
acceptance_criteria: Recommendation cards render per-route and per-model with: current config snapshot, recommended change (batch size, cache TTL, prefix cache enablement, quantization profile), estimated monthly savings (USD), predicted P95 latency delta, confidence band, and a short rationale.

Diff preview modal shows an inline, human-readable change set across affected routes/models and runtime config keys with a toggle to view raw JSON/YAML and a side-by-side ‘before/after’ token-cost model used for savings estimate.

Apply action creates an immutable ledger entry containing: user, timestamp, applied diff, canary settings, linked runbook/PR, and optional justification notes. Ledger entries are exportable (CSV) and searchable in Console Audit view.

Canary apply flow lets users choose traffic percentages (0.5%, 1%, 5%) and monitoring windows (5, 15, 60 minutes). If health checks (errors, P95 latency) breach thresholds, the platform auto-rolls back and writes a rollback ledger entry with reason and diagnostic links.
Manual rollback button is available on any ledger entry and creates a new ledger entry that references the original apply; rollback is also audited and supports an optional comment.
Recommendation confidence score and example prompt/test used to derive latency and token estimates are visible on the card and linked to the evaluation artifact so PM/Eng can reproduce estimates.
All flows pass accessibility (WCAG AA) and include telemetry events for UX funnels: view_card, open_preview, apply_canary, apply_full, auto_rollback, manual_rollback.
Security review completed for ledger integrity and RBAC gating prior to release; design vetted with Compliance and SRE teams.
